arxiv-2106-00123.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning in Quantitative Algorithmic Trading: A Review
arxiv-2106-00123.creator: Tidor-Vlad Pricope
arxiv-2106-00123.description: Abstract Algorithmic stock trading has become a staple in today’s financial market, the majority of trades being now fully automated. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) agents proved to be to a force to be reckon with in many complex games like Chess and Go.

arxiv-2508-16979.title: Iterative Methods for Computing the Moore–Penrose Pseudoinverse of Quaternion Matrices, with Applications
arxiv-2508-16979.creator: Valentin Leplat, Salman Ahmadi-Asl, JunJun Pan, Ning Zheng
arxiv-2508-16979.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Valentin Leplat, Salman Ahmadi-Asl, JunJun Pan, Ning Zheng. We develop quaternion–native iterative methods for computing the Moore–Penrose (MP) pseudoinverse of quaternion matrices and analyze their convergence. Our starting point is a damped Newton–Schulz (NS) iteration tailored to noncommutativity: we enforce the appropriate left/right identities for rectangular inputs and prove convergence directly in ℍ \mathbb{H} under a simple spectral scaling X 0 = α ​ A H X_{0}=\alpha A^{H} with α ∈ ( 0 , 2 / ‖ A ‖ 2 2 ) \alpha\in(0,2/\|A\|_{2}^{2}) .

arxiv-2509-16718.title: Idiosyncratic Versus Normative Modeling of Atypical Speech Recognition: Dysarthric Case Studies
arxiv-2509-16718.creator: Vishnu Raja, Adithya V Ganesan, Anand Syamkumar, Ritwik Banerjee, H. Andrew Schwartz, {visraja, avirinchipur, asyamkumar, rbanerjee, has}@cs.stonybrook.edu
arxiv-2509-16718.description: Abstract State-of-the-art automatic speech recognition (ASR) models like Whisper, perform poorly on atypical speech, such as that produced by individuals with dysarthria. Past works for atypical speech have mostly investigated fully personalized (or idiosyncratic) models, but modeling strategies that can both generalize and handle idiosyncracy could be more effective for capturing atypical speech.

arxiv-2512-03033.title: The Gamma-disordered Aztec diamond
arxiv-2512-03033.creator: Maurice Duits, Roger Van Peski
arxiv-2512-03033.description: Abstract . We introduce a multi-parameter family of random edge weights on the Aztec diamond graph, given by certain Gamma variables, and prove several results about the corresponding random dimer measures. Firstly, we show there is no phase transition at the level of the free energy.

pmc-10662610.title: N-linked glycans: an underappreciated key determinant of T cell development, activation, and function
pmc-10662610.creator: Mahmoud Abdelbary, Jeffrey C. Nolz
pmc-10662610.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). N-linked glycosylation is a post-translational modification that results in the decoration of newly synthesized proteins with diverse types of oligosaccharides that originate from the amide group of the amino acid asparagine. The sequential and collective action of multiple glycosidases and glycosyltransferases are responsible for determining the overall size, composition, and location of N-linked glycans that become covalently linked to an asparagine during and after protein translation.

pmc-11530468.title: Advanced Regenerative Medicines for Rare Diseases: A Review of Industry Sponsors Investment Motivations
pmc-11530468.creator: Ubaka Ogbogu, Anja Nel
pmc-11530468.description: Despite regulatory changes designed to stimulate investment in therapies for rare diseases, many of these conditions lack government-approved treatments. Advanced regenerative medicines, which are therapies and clinical interventions aimed at healing or replacing damaged or defective human cells, tissues, and organs, offer great promise for addressing many rare diseases.

pmc-11569215.title: Leveraging infrared spectroscopy for automated structure elucidation
pmc-11569215.creator: Marvin Alberts, Teodoro Laino, Alain C. Vaucher
pmc-11569215.description: The application of machine learning models in chemistry has made remarkable strides in recent years. While analytical chemistry has received considerable interest from machine learning practitioners, its adoption into everyday use remains limited. Among the available analytical methods, Infrared (IR) spectroscopy stands out in terms of affordability, simplicity, and accessibility.

pmc-11654311.title: Impact of different antiretroviral therapy regimens on bone mineral density in people living with HIV: a retrospective and longitudinal study in China
pmc-11654311.creator: Xuelei Liang, Hanxi Zhang, Mingnan Guo, Hongxin Zhao, Di Yang, Rui Sun, Xiaojie Lao, Yali Xu, Fengting Yu, Fujie Zhang
pmc-11654311.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundHIV infection and antiretroviral therapy (ART) are associated with bone loss of people living with HIV (PLWH), but limited studies exist on the impacts of ART regimens on bone mineral density (BMD) in China.

pmc-12712847.title: Pyrazoline B Induces Oxidative Stress Mediated Toxicity, Cell Cycle Arrest, and Caspase-Independent Apoptosis in BT-474 Human Breast Cancer Cells
pmc-12712847.creator: Hesti Lina Wiraswati, Pamungkas Bagus Satriyo, Muhammad Hasan Bashari, Eti Nurwening Sholikhah, Tutik Dwi Wahyuningsih, Ilma Fauziah Ma’ruf, Chi-Tai Yeh, Mustofa Mustofa
pmc-12712847.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionLuminal subtype B breast cancer represents a clinically challenging subtype, accounting for nearly 40% of all breast cancers. However, clinical outcomes remain suboptimal due to challenges such as poor solubility, resistance, and drug-induced toxicity. In our previous work, a synthesized compound pyrazoline B demonstrated potent toxicity effects towards T47D, 4T1, and Hs578T breast cancer cells, WiDr colorectal cancer cells, and HeLa cervical cancer cells.

pmc-13070036.title: Estimating seepage in heterogeneous earthfill dams on permeable foundations using explainable machine learning
pmc-13070036.creator: Mohamed Maher Sayed Ahmed, Muhammad Zeeshan Khursheed, Badee Alshameri, Abdelrahman Kamal Hamed, Mohamed Kamel Elshaarawy
pmc-13070036.description: Predicting seepage discharge through heterogeneous earthfill dams founded on permeable foundations is essential for dam safety and long-term water-resources sustainability. Accordingly, this study evaluated five machine learning (ML) models viz Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), Stochastic Gradient Boosting (SGB), Light Gradient Boosting (LGB), and Categorical Gradient Boosting (CGB), to estimate seepage discharge using seven geometric and hydraulic input variables.

pmc-13100560.title: Diamine Grafting of Pyrazole‐Based MOF‐303 for Diluted‐Source CO2 Capture
pmc-13100560.creator: Giuseppe Mastronardi, Jacopo Perego, Charl Xavier Bezuidenhout, Wim Temmerman, Veronique Van Speybroeck, Valentina Crocellà, Silvia Bracco, Nello Li Pira, Angiolina Comotti, Silvia Bordiga
pmc-13100560.description: Amine‐functionalized materials have been extensively investigated for CO2 capture, with adsorption mechanisms based primarily on carbamate formation. Among the different strategies, grafting amine moieties onto porous solid supports represents a benchmark approach for developing highly effective adsorbents, even at very low CO2 concentrations.

pmc-13539072.title: Pre‐Emptive TIPS for Acute Variceal Bleeding: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-13539072.creator: Wan Muhammad Izhar bin Wan Ismail, Susmitha Chalamalasetti, Faraz Iqbal, Karan Garg, Aashni Purohit, Hariniska Jayaraman Kannan, Kalyanramnaidu Botsa, Basel Al Khatib, Yaseen Sulaiman, Amar Abdalrazak, Muhammad Safiullah, Asma’a Munasar Ali Alsubari, Adnan Bhat, Muhammad Abu Zar, Prasun K Jalal, Dir
pmc-13539072.description: BackgroundThere is evolving evidence regarding whether pre‐emptive transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (p‐TIPS) improves outcomes in patients with acute variceal bleeding. This meta‐analysis is aimed at evaluating the effectiveness of p‐TIPS compared with standard care in reducing mortality and rebleeding in high‐risk patients with cirrhosis.MethodsWe systematically searched CENTRAL, MEDLINE, Embase, and ClinicalTrials.
